artifact_observations.reasoning: The yellow figure has a noisy, stippled texture that looks like digital noise or a failed texture generation rather than a coherent print or embroidery. It lacks clear edges.

The face printed on the bib is distorted. The facial features are asymmetrical and slightly 'melted,' typical of AI struggling with rendering faces within textures. The crown structure is also ill-defined.
The baby's fingers blending into the white straps of the bib show slight edge bleeding and lack of clear separation, suggesting minor fusion artifacts.
There is text on the white tag/strap area, but it is illegible gibberish, a common AI artifact when attempting to render labels.
